decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Birthing Ritual and Coiling Oracle to play powerful creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl and Harbinger of the Seas. It also includes disruptive spells like Force of Negation and Sink into Stupor to control the game. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and control, utilizing the Simic color combination to maximize efficiency and versatility. Ultimately, the goal is to establish early board presence and tempo advantage to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells. It also aims to gain card advantage through cards like Thought Scour and Unearth while controlling the board with creatures like Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus. The inclusion of graveyard value cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Ketramose, the New Dawn adds versatility to the deck. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's three-color identity and ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly cycle through cards using cards like Street Wraith and Shardless Agent, while controlling the board with counter spells like Force of Negation and disruptive creatures. The goal is to discard a high number of creatures early in the game, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a sudden and powerful board presence. The deck also includes some alternative win conditions like Colossal Skyturtle and Windcaller Aven to provide additional avenues to victory.

The main focus of this Modern 1 vs 1 control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through removal and resource denial while building up your own board state. The deck utilizes various forms of removal such as Wrath of the Skies and Path to Exile, as well as cards like Crucible of Worlds and Ghost Quarter to control the opponent's resources. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and disruption. The deck also includes cards like Lay Down Arms and March of Otherworldly Light to protect your own creatures and generate value. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to control the game state and outvalue the opponent.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a strong board presence and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. The key strategy revolves around utilizing cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls to boost the power and resilience of your creatures, while cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge provide additional damage to control the board. By efficiently utilizing your resources and prioritizing early aggression, this deck aims to end the game swiftly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Tainted Indulgence. It also utilizes cards like Force of Negation and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Atraxa, Grand Unifier helps to control the board and provide additional value. The deck aims to win the game through explosive plays and overwhelming the opponent with big threats. The inclusion of instant reanimation spells and strong control elements make the deck versatile and difficult for opponents to predict and counter.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays combined with the ability to "blink" or flicker creatures for value. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push while deploying powerful threats such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phage, Titan of Fire's Fury. By utilizing cards like Flickerwisp and Solitude, the deck can protect its creatures and generate additional value from their enters-the-battlefield abilities. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy while also allowing for flexibility in casting various spells.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through a combination of powerful Eldrazi creatures and the UrzaTron lands. By assembling Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine, the player can access a large amount of mana to cast their Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Sire of Seven Deaths. Additionally, cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms provide additional control elements and disruption for the opponent. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm and outvalue the opponent with the deck's powerful threats and control elements.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to utilize fast and aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to provide additional firepower. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls support the aggro strategy by providing buffs and additional creatures. Cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison help control the board and protect your creatures, while Arena of Glory provides additional benefits for attacking. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a mix of creatures and spells.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while also exploiting the effects of blinking and flickering cards to gain value and disrupt their strategy. By combining aggressive creatures like Emperor of Bones and Overlord of the Balemurk with flicker effects like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to further disrupt the opponent's strategy and allow the aggro creatures to get through.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponent's strategies with a mix of hand disruption, counterspells, removal, and graveyard recursion. It utilizes a combination of control elements like Thoughtseize, Counterspell, Fatal Push, and Force of Negation to manage threats while also including Unearth for graveyard value. The inclusion of Murktide Regent and Ketramose, the New Dawn offers additional threats while Cling to Dust provides graveyard hate. The land base is designed to ensure consistent mana supply for the deck's spells. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue opponents through resource management.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Mine) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes powerful control elements like Chalice of the Void, Ugin, Eye of the Storms, and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect its own game plan. The deck also includes Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Sire of Seven Deaths to apply pressure and close out the game. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to ramp up quickly, control the game, and finish off the opponent with powerful threats.

This control deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant) to generate massive amounts of mana and play powerful Eldrazi creatures. The deck uses cards like All Is Dust and Ugin, the Eye of the Storms to sweep the board and disrupt the opponent's strategies, while also utilizing cards like Karn, the Great Creator to shut down artifacts and fetch important pieces. Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void are used to slow down the opponent's game plan, making it difficult for them to effectively respond to the threats presented by the deck.

The key concept of this Modern Aggro - Affinity deck is to play low-cost artifacts and creatures quickly to deliver fast and consistent damage to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Memnite, Ornithopter, and Pinnacle Emissary alongside artifact mana sources like Mox Opal and Springleaf Drum, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. Thoughtcast and Thought Monitor provide card advantage to keep the pressure on, while Cranial Plating and Urza's Saga serve as powerful tools to increase the deck's offensive capabilities.

The focus of this Jeskai Control deck is to manipulate the game through various forms of control. With cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Negation to disrupt opponents, alongside powerful removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Consign to Memory, the deck aims to slow down the game and control the board. It also utilizes cards like Tune the Narrative and Consult the Star Charts to draw cards and find necessary tools for victory. The win condition of the deck revolves around Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, using it to close out games with its powerful abilities.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize the Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana and take advantage of the land ramp from cards like Primeval Titan and Explore to quickly assemble the necessary lands to win the game with cards like Scapeshift. The deck also includes various utility lands and spell recursion like Tolaria West and Aftermath Analyst to enhance the combo potential of the Amulet Titan archetype, ultimately aiming to overwhelm the opponent with powerful land plays and creature summons.
